set.body: From the UI-C re-review (2026-09-26, APPROVE at 605e681). F1: the ReportOf resolver checks digests and member keys but not values. A hand-edited report@1 (e.g. +1000 on every estimate) or a report written by an older reduction resolves as current. Fix: once the digest checks pass, rebuild the source via codec ReportSources.study from the decoded plan, input, result and ledger and require Report.evaluate(spec, source) == stored, refusing with a typed error that names the first differing cell. The cost is one set of window tallies plus a linear reduction, with no pair scoring. This subsumes F2: member references at the wrong scale resolve today, because ArtifactResolution's ReportOf branch drops each ref's scale (loci.flatMap(_.trialKeys)), so ResultInspection drill-down fails. Optional: add Report.reduce/reconstruct and ReportSource.of/study/fromQueries to StudioLint's forbidden list.
set.title: Report resolver re-evaluates the stored report (UI-C follow-up)
